description: On-device and server Visual Intelligence labels for Hazard Reporter (wires, potholes, road damage, debris).

classes.title: Hanging / damaged wire
cues: Visible sag or loop between poles
Wire resting on ground, fence, or vegetation

classes.title: Pothole
cues: Circular or irregular cavity in asphalt
Broken pavement crater in travel lane

classes.title: Road damage
cues: Missing asphalt without a deep cavity

classes.title: Debris / obstacle
cues: Fallen branch, trash, or rubble hazard
